inputs.text: Tens of thousands of people marched through central London on Saturday to protest the far-right, six months after Britain saw one of its largest-ever far-right demonstrations and weeks ahead of key local elections. The Together Alliance event was organised by hundreds of groups, including trade unions, anti-racism campaigners and Muslim representative bodies, and it was billed as the biggest.
